key_reasoning.reason: Touches five components across the activity subsystem — API models (activity_event.py), a new taxonomy lookup module, the repository (category-based filtering query), the service (metadata/category enrichment), the project-scoped router, plus an incidental touch in project_service.py — crossing API, Service, and DB-Persistence layers and introducing a new abstraction (the event-type-to-label/category taxonomy).

activity_taxonomy.py intentionally raises KeyError for any event_type not present in EVENT_TAXONOMY (get_label/get_category), by design rather than degrading gracefully. This creates an ongoing maintenance coupling: any new event_type emitted elsewhere in the codebase (budget, project, user domains) that is not added to the taxonomy will surface as a runtime failure in the activity API rather than a silent gap. No existing precedent for this fail-hard mapping pattern was found in the repo.
